name: desi-fighter
description: Browser-based 2D fighting game built around Indian political satire.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @desi-fighter/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,web,server -c blue,cyan,magenta "npm:dev:shared" "npm:dev:web" "npm:dev:server"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build -w @desi-fighter/web -w @desi-fighter/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @desi-fighter/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
